doctor.en: Doctors and nurses are busy at night.

fireman.en: The fireman saves people from the fire.

police.en: Police officers and firemen work at night, too.
police.zh: 警察和消防队员也在夜间工作。

police officer.en: A police officer helps keep the city safe.
police officer.zh: 警察帮助维护城市安全。

station.en: I want to work in a fire station.

police station.en: I want to work at a police station.

worker.zh: 他是做什么的？他是一名工人。

aunt.zh: 你姑姑/阿姨是做什么工作的？

night.en: Yes, I come out at night.

night owl.en: My dad is a night owl and reads late.
night owl.zh: 我爸爸是个夜猫子，读书到很晚。

driver.zh: 公交车司机和出租车司机在夜间工作。

taxi.zh: 公交车司机和出租车司机在夜间工作。

nurse.en: Doctors and nurses are busy at night.

light.en: They light up the night for others.
light.zh: 他们为其他人照亮夜晚。

bee.en: He is like a bee, very busy.
bee.zh: 他像一只蜜蜂，非常忙碌。

often.en: But he often works in the fields.
often.zh: 但是他经常在田里劳作。

field.en: But he often works in the fields.
field.zh: 但是他经常在田里劳作。

use.en: But he uses his brush a lot.
use.zh: 但是他经常用他的画笔。

brush.en: But he uses his brush a lot.
brush.zh: 但是他经常用他的画笔。

scientist.zh: 我知道了！他是一名科学家！

writer.en: The writer writes stories for children.
writer.zh: 这位作家为孩子们写故事。

sound.en: Which words have the same sound?

postman.en: The postman brings letters every morning.

life.en: Life is full of fun and surprises.
life.zh: 生活充满了乐趣和惊喜。

mountain.en: Ge Jun brings food to people on the mountains.
mountain.zh: 葛军把食物送到山上的人们那里。

opera.zh: 这是我和玲玲第一次看京剧演出。

next.en: We can do it next time.

gift.en: A birthday gift for Ms Whale?

model.en: Thank you! It's the new model ship!
model.zh: 谢谢！这是新的轮船模型！

should.en: You should brush your teeth every day.

huge.en: You feel angry, like the colour of a huge fire.
huge.zh: 你感到生气，就像一团大火的颜色。

act.en: You can play the piano. I can act.

magic.en: He can do magic with a hat.

puzzle.zh: 她看一眼就能拼好拼图。

boy.en: Why are you crying, my boy?

seed.en: I'm a little seed, small and cute.
seed.zh: 我是一颗小小的种子，又小又可爱。

earth.en: Put me in the earth, and watch me grow.
earth.zh: 把我放进泥土里，看着我长大。

leaf.en: A green leaf fell from the tree.
leaf.zh: 一片绿叶从树上落下来。

plant.en: Let me plant a new one.

dream.en: I think his dreams will come true!

will.en: I think his dreams will come true!

true.en: I think his dreams will come true!

come true.en: I think his dreams will come true!

keeper.zh: 我们去叫森林管理员吧！

hey.en: Hey, look at that big bird!

lovely.en: What a lovely sunny day it is!

student.en: I want to teach students Chinese.

culture.en: We learn a lot about the Zhuang culture from these activities.
culture.zh: 我们从这些活动中学到了很多壮族文化。

design.en: Design a stand for your hometown.
design.zh: 为你的家乡设计一个展台。

hometown.en: Design a stand for your hometown.
hometown.zh: 为你的家乡设计一个展台。

T-shirt.en: He's wearing a T-shirt and shorts.

shorts.en: He's wearing a T-shirt and shorts.

dress.zh: 我在找我的蓝色连衣裙。

party.zh: 你想穿什么去参加聚会？

dressmaker.en: Find the best dressmaker for me.

wrong.zh: 爸爸总把我们的名字叫错。

clever.en: The clever boy can solve the puzzle.
clever.zh: 那个聪明的男孩能解开这个谜题。

whale.en: A birthday gift for Ms Whale?
whale.zh: 给鲸鱼女士的生日礼物？

robe.en: A white robe, for nurses and doctors.
robe.zh: 白色的长袍，给护士和医生穿。

dot.en: Put a dot at the end of the sentence.
